limitations: Harvest is firm-anchored (query.spons) and independent of any regulatory record; no server-side date filter was used.
fields= requested exactly the frozen list of 25 fields; compact file drops nothing else from the study object.

Date window filter applied client-side to first_posted in [2010-01-01, 2025-12-31]; rows with null first_posted are retained. Upstream date strings are kept verbatim (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM); no day is invented.

Dedup by nct_id: the first query that returned a study owns the record; additional query strings are appended to api_query joined by ' | '. Records returned by more than one query therefore keep the first record's source_firm and fetched_at.
Raw unique records before the window filter: 2407; dropped as out-of-window: 605; retained: 1802.
Retained records: 1802; per firm (first-owner attribution): medtronic=1215, ge_healthcare=258, philips=316, draeger=8, mindray=5.
Retained records with at least one interventions[] entry of type DEVICE: 1073.
Distinct nct_id returned by more than one query (retained set): 3.
per_field_nulls counts records whose value is null; for list-valued fields (phases, conditions, interventions, collaborators, countries, secondary_ids) an empty list is counted as null.

queried records_returned is the count of studies returned by the API for that query (pre-filter, pre-dedup); records_retained is the count of that query's nct_ids present in the final retained file, so a study returned by several queries counts under each of them. requests counts HTTP attempts including retries; pages counts successfully processed pages.
fetched_at is wall-clock time at page retrieval and is the only non-deterministic field; everything else is deterministic given identical upstream bytes. Gzip is written with mtime=0.
